learning_experiences: kutambua maneno yanayotumiwa katika maamkuzi na maagano (k.v. Umeamkaje? Umeshindaje? Safiri salama, mchana mwema, usiku mwema) kutoka kwenye chati, vitabu, kadi maneno, mti maneno, michoro, picha au vifaa vya kidijitali akiwa na wenzake,
kujadili na wenzake picha, michoro, video n.k. zinazoonyesha vitendo vya maamkuzi na maagano,
kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano akiwa na wenzake ili kujenga umilisi wa kutumia maneno haya,
kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake maamkuzi na maagano kutoka kwa jamii yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua maamkuzi na maagano yapi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuwasiliana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli mbalimbali za kikundi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposikiliza kwa makini maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali kutoka kwenye vifaa vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika mijadala ya maamkuzi na maagano darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya heshima na adabu katika maamkuzi na maagano.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake maamkuzi na maagano kutoka kwa jamii yake.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya maamukuzi na maagano anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali yatumiwayo katika jamii
kutumia ipasavyo maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali yatumiwayo katika jamii
kuthamini matumizi ya maamkuzi na maagano katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tumia maamkuzi na maagano yafaayo na majibu yake
skills.mastery: Chooses the greeting or farewell that fits who is met (a friend, an elder, a group), the time of day and whether arriving or leaving, and gives the right reply (Hujambo? Sijambo; Shikamoo, Marahaba; Hamjambo? Hatujambo), in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Greeting and answering at the times of day (Grade 2) comes before the wider greetings of the community.
Words of respect of Grade 2 carry into greeting elders.

misconceptions.error: Answers a greeting with the same greeting (Hujambo? Hujambo!) instead of its reply.
misconceptions.cause: The child hears the greeting as a sound to echo, as with "Hello" in English; the question-and-answer pair has not been learnt.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakusalimu: "Hujambo?" Unajibu nini?" with "Hujambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act it as a ball game: the greeting is thrown, the reply is caught; the two words are on two different cards.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukiulizwa "Hujambo?" unajibu "Sijambo," maana yake sina tatizo.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Greets an elder with a peer or Sheng greeting (Mambo! Sasa!) instead of Shikamoo.
misconceptions.cause: Mambo and Sasa are what the child hears most among children and on the street; he has not been taught that an elder is greeted differently.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamwona babu njiani. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Mambo babu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort picture cards of people (babu, rafiki, mwalimu) into two piles: Shikamoo and Hujambo.
misconceptions.feedback: Mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the elder's reply to the child's greeting the wrong way round (the elder says Shikamoo, or the child says Marahaba).

example.question: Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?

misconceptions.cause: Both words are heard together and the child does not yet know which belongs to the young person and which to the elder.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Role-play with a hat for the elder: only the one with the hat may say Marahaba.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtoto anasema Shikamoo; mzee anajibu Marahaba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the greeting of another time of day.

example.question: Unamkuta mwalimu shuleni saa nne asubuhi. Unamsalimu vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child learnt one greeting as a set phrase and uses it at every hour.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamkuta mwalimu shuleni saa nne asubuhi. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Habari za jioni mwalimu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A clock or sun chart: asubuhi, mchana, jioni, usiku; the child moves the arrow and says the greeting for that time.
misconceptions.feedback: Salamu hufuata wakati: Habari za asubuhi mwalimu!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a greeting when leaving, or a farewell when arriving.

example.question: Rafiki anasafiri kwenda kijijini. Unamuaga vipi?

misconceptions.cause: Greeting and farewell words are learnt on one chart and the child mixes the two columns.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anasafiri kwenda kijijini. Unamuaga vipi?" with "Karibu sana!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out a door: walk in and greet, walk out and say goodbye.
misconceptions.feedback: Unapoondoka unaaga: Safiri salama!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Greets a group with the singular greeting (Hujambo?) or answers for a group with Sijambo.

example.question: Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows one pair only; the plural forms hamjambo/hatujambo follow the person marker (m-, tu-), which has not been noticed.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?" with "Sijambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Greet one child, then the whole row; show that the word changes with one or many.
misconceptions.feedback: Watu wengi hujibu "Hatujambo."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 51- 54 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (k.v. uzalendo, umoja, undugu, ushirikiano, upendo) akiwa na wenzake,
kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano,
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutabiri ujumbe wa kifungu kwa kutazama picha kwenye kitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali au chati akiwa na wenzake,
kuthibitisha utabiri wake kuhusu hadithi baada ya kuisoma,
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akiwa na wenzake,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unapenda kusoma hadithi za aina gani?
Je, ni mambo gani unayoweza kujifunza kutokana na hadithi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapojadili picha, kutabiri na kudhibitisha utabiri kuhusu hadithi.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotoa muhtasari wa hadithi aliyoisoma.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Usalama wa mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma ufahamu kuhusu suala lengwa na kuzingatia usalama mtandaoni.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufahamu anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi: msamiati, ujumbe, kutabiri na mafunzo
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage on uzalendo, gives the meaning of a theme word from the sentence around it, says the message, predicts what happens next from the clues and says the lesson, answering from the passage and not from his own life, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Saying the message of a short passage in Grade 2 comes first.
Saying the lesson of a short story in Grade 2.

misconceptions.error: Gives "bendera" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Kila Jumatatu, wanafunzi wa Shule ya Amani hukusanyika uwanjani. Wanaimba wimbo wa taifa huku bendera ikipandishwa. Wote husimama wima kwa heshima." Neno "bendera" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Soma: "Kila Jumatatu, wanafunzi wa Shule ya Amani hukusanyika uwanjani. Wanaimba wimbo wa taifa huku bendera ikipandishwa. Wote husimama wima kwa heshima." Neno "bendera" lina maana gani?" with "bandari" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika kifungu, "bendera" ni kitambaa chenye rangi kinachowakilisha nchi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tunaheshimu wimbo wa taifa na bendera ya nchi yetu.

misconceptions.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Wanafunzi hukusanyika siku ya Jumatatu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tunaheshimu wimbo wa taifa na bendera ya nchi yetu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for.

example.question: Wimbo wa taifa ukiisha, wanafunzi watafanya nini?

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wimbo wa taifa ukiisha, wanafunzi watafanya nini?" with "Wataenda nyumbani kulala." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the clue words; the guess must fit them.
misconceptions.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za kifungu: Wataenda madarasani kuanza masomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kuipenda na kuiheshimu nchi yetu.

misconceptions.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Wanafunzi waliimba na bendera ikapandishwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuipenda na kuiheshimu nchi yetu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.

example.question: Wanafunzi husimamaje wimbo wa taifa unapoimbwa?

misconceptions.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wanafunzi husimamaje wimbo wa taifa unapoimbwa?" with "Mimi huimba nikiwa nimeketi nyumbani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: Husimama wima kwa heshima.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua mambo mbalimbali yanayozingatiwa kufanikisha hati nadhifu (k.v. muundo wa herufi, nafasi ifaayo kati ya maneno, nafasi zifaazo pambizoni, kutenganisha sentensi ifaavyo, usafi wa nakala) kutoka kwenye kitabu, chati, vifaa vya kidijitali akiwa na wenzake,
kunakili kifungu cha maneno yasiyozidi 30 kwa hati nadhifu kutoka kwenye kitabu, chati au vifaa vya kidijitali,
kuandika kifungu cha maneno yasiyozidi 30 akizingatia hatua za uandishi (k.v. maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi) na kuwasomea wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia mambo gani unapoandika kifungu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili mambo ya kuzingatiwa ili kufanikisha hati nadhifu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika ujifunzaji.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli mbalimbali za kuandika.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaponakili kifungu cha maneno kwa hati nadhifu.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya maandishi bora na anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua mambo yanayozingatiwa kufanikisha hati nadhifu
kuandika kifungu cha maneno kati ya 25-30 kwa hati nadhifu
kufurahia kuandika kwa hati nadhifu ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika kifungu kwa hati nadhifu
skills.mastery: Writes a passage of about 25-30 words in neat handwriting: letters well formed and on the line, space between words, through the steps to a clean copy, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Writing sentences in neat handwriting (Grade 2) comes before a whole passage.
Leaving space between words (Grade 2).

misconceptions.error: Hands in the first draft with crossings and does not make a clean copy.

example.question: Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks writing ends when the words are down; the steps maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi are new.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?" with "nakala ya kwanza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show the four steps as four boxes; the child ticks each one.
misconceptions.feedback: Baada ya kurekebisha, andika nakala safi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out words or a whole line when copying.
misconceptions.cause: The child copies letter by letter and loses his place when looking back.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Nakili: "Kenya ni nchi yetu nzuri."" with "Kenya nchi yetu nzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Copy phrase by phrase, moving a finger along the line; read the copy back against the original.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma nakala yako na ulinganishe na ya asili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves no space between words (Mamaanapika).
misconceptions.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a finger space after every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
misconceptions.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matumizi ya Yeye na Wao (Theme 1: Uzalendo)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza kifungu au wimbo unaohusu yeye na wao kutoka kwa mwalimu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutambua neno yeye na wao kutoka kifungu alichokisikiliza,
kusoma vifungu na kutambua neno yeye na wao akiwa na wenzake au katika kikundi,
kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia yeye na wao,
kutumia yeye na wao katika kuigiza mazungumzo na wenzake katika kikundi (k.v.Yeye anasoma - wao wanasoma).
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani unayoyatumia kuwataja wenzako bila kutumia majina yao halisi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kutoa mifano kwa kutumia yeye na wao.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya yeye na wao.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza matumizi ya yeye na wao.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia yeye na wao ifaavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutunga sentensi.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kikundi huku akisikiliza michango yao na kutoa maoni.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia maneno lengwa.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi na kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya nafsi ya sarufi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities

outcomes.text: kutambua neno yeye na wao katika sentensi
kutumia neno yeye na wao ipasavyo katika sentensi
kufurahia kutumia neno yeye na wao katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia yeye na wao ipasavyo katika sentensi
skills.mastery: Uses yeye for one person (a boy or a girl) and wao for many, with the matching subject marker on the verb (yeye a-, wao wa-), and switches to yeye when answering about someone else, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Using wewe and nyinyi with their verbs (Grade 2) shows the pattern of a pronoun pair.
Huyo and hao (Grade 2) already separate one person from many.

misconceptions.error: The pronoun and the subject marker on the verb do not agree (Wao anacheza).
misconceptions.cause: The child learns the pronoun as a word and the verb as a fixed form; he has not seen that the verb changes with the person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Wao ___ (cheza) mpira." with "anacheza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Colour the pronoun and the verb's first syllable the same colour: yeye a-, wao wa-, mimi ni-, sisi tu-, wewe u-, nyinyi m-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendo hufuata nafsi: Wao wanacheza; Yeye anacheza. (wanacheza)
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the one-person pronoun for many people, or the reverse.
misconceptions.cause: The child has not linked the pronoun pair to one and many.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Juma na Ali wanasoma. ___ wanasoma." with "Yeye" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point at one child, then at a group, saying the right pronoun each time.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtu mmoja ni yeye; watu wengi ni wao. (Wao)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Thinks yeye is for a boy only and looks for another word for a girl (English he/she).

example.question: Amina anapika. Mtaje kwa neno moja: ___ anapika.

misconceptions.cause: English separates he and she; Kiswahili yeye is any one person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Amina anapika. Mtaje kwa neno moja: ___ anapika." with "Wao" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Use yeye for Amina and for Juma in the same lesson; ask the class to find the difference (there is none).
misconceptions.feedback: Yeye ni mtu mmoja, mvulana au msichana. (Yeye)
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Repeats the pronoun of the question in the answer (Wewe unaenda wapi? Wewe ninaenda sokoni.) instead of switching to mimi.
misconceptions.cause: The child copies the words he heard; changing person between speakers is new.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mama anauliza: "Baba yuko wapi?" Unajibu:" with "Wewe yuko shambani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask and answer in pairs with a pointing finger: wewe points out, mimi points to the chest.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukiulizwa kwa "wewe", unajibu kwa "mimi". (Yeye yuko shambani.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matamshi Bora: Vokali na Konsonanti za Kiswahili (Theme 2: Shambani)
learning_experiences: kutambua vokali za Kiswahili katika matini ya kutamkwa au kuandikwa,
kutamka ipasavyo vokali za Kiswahili,
kutambua konsonanti za Kiswahili katika matini ya kutamkwa au kuandikwa,
kutamka ipasavyo konsonanti za Kiswahili,

sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuzisikiliza, kuzitambua na kuzitamka vokali na konsonanti za Kiswahili.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza vokali na konsonanti za Kiswahili na kujirekodi akizitamka.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapozitamka vokali na konsonanti za Kiswahili kwa mzazi au mlezi wake ipasavyo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapokuwa makini kusikiliza vokali na konsonanti zikitamkwa na mwalimu.

skills.name: Tambua na utamke vokali na konsonanti za Kiswahili
skills.mastery: Names the five Kiswahili vowels (a, e, i, o, u), tells a vowel from a consonant, says each with its Kiswahili sound (not the English letter name), and treats ch, sh, dh, th, gh, ny, ng' as one consonant each, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Recognising the sounds of the Kiswahili alphabet (Grade 2) is the base for sorting them into vowels and consonants.
Finding those sounds in a read passage in Grade 2.

misconceptions.error: Counts y (and sometimes w) as a vowel.

example.question: Ni zipi ni irabu za Kiswahili?
example.wrong_answer: a, e, i, o, u, y

misconceptions.cause: English lessons teach that y is "sometimes a vowel"; Kiswahili has five vowels only.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni zipi ni irabu za Kiswahili?" with "a, e, i, o, u, y" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort letter cards into two baskets; y and w go with the consonants.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiswahili kina irabu tano tu: a, e, i, o, u.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Counts a two-letter consonant (sh, ch, ny, dh) as two sounds.
misconceptions.cause: The child counts letters, not sounds.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "shamba" linaanza na konsonanti ngapi?" with "mbili: s na h" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the sound alone (sh!) and show it is one sound on one card.
misconceptions.feedback: "sh" ni sauti moja, ingawa ina herufi mbili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says the English letter name for a vowel (i as "ai", e as "ii").
misconceptions.cause: English letter names were learnt alongside; the child uses them for the Kiswahili sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Irabu "i" katika neno "iko" inatamkwaje?" with "ai" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sing the Kiswahili vowel song with each vowel sound held.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili, "i" inatamkwa /i/, kama katika "iko".
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes u and o (or i and e) in speech and writing (kuku said and written koko).

example.question: Ni lipi sahihi kwa ndege wa nyumbani anayetaga mayai?

misconceptions.cause: Some Kenyan first languages have seven vowels, with sounds between u and o and between i and e; the child hears the Kiswahili vowels through them.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi kwa ndege wa nyumbani anayetaga mayai?" with "koko" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Mouth shapes with a mirror: round and small for u, round and open for o.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza: "kuku" ina /u/ mara mbili.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Does not tell ng' from ng (ngoma and ng'ombe start with the same sound to the child).

example.question: Ni neno lipi lina sauti ng' mwanzoni?

misconceptions.cause: Ng' has no /g/ after the nasal; the child hears both as one.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti ng' mwanzoni?" with "ngoma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say ngoma and ng'ombe with a hand on the throat: the /g/ of ngoma is felt.
misconceptions.feedback: Ng'ombe: sauti ng' bila /g/; ngoma: ng yenye /g/.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua sauti lengwa (/bw/, /fy/, /kw/) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 47 kwa dakika na kwa kuzingatia viakifishi) akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, n.k. akiwa na wenzake akizingatia sauti inayosikika, matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na ishara zifaazo,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora,sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara zifaazo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, utafanya mambo gani unaposoma ili uweze kusikika vizuri?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kusoma kwa ufasaha akiwa na wenzake.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa huku akizingatia matamshi bora, sauti inayosika, kasi ifaayo na ishara zifaazo.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi kutambua sauti lengwa kwa ufasaha na kutumia vifaa vya kidijitali.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza kifaa cha kidijitali anachotumia kujifunzia.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anaposoma hadithi yenye sauti lengwa kutoka kwa kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia hatua za kiusalama.
Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu na wenzake kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufasaha anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti /bw/, /fy/, /kw/ kwa matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Finds the target sounds /bw/, /fy/, /kw/ in a short story, reads it aloud with every sound clear, loud enough for the class, at about 47 words a minute, pausing at the koma and kikomo and raising the voice for a question; in the app picks the better reading of a line, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Reading a short story with target sounds and good pronunciation in Grade 2 comes first.
Saying each vowel and consonant clearly is the base of reading aloud.

misconceptions.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "bwana" as "buwana".
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "bwana" linasomwa vipi?" with "buwana" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma "bwana" kama lilivyoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Bwana Juma analima shamba la mahindi."?
example.wrong_answer: Bwana ... Juma ... analima ... shamba ... la ... mahindi.
example.correct_answer: Bwana Juma analima shamba la mahindi.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Bwana Juma analima shamba la mahindi."?" with "Bwana ... Juma ... analima ... shamba ... la ... mahindi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 47 kwa dakika

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeona fyekeo la Bwana Juma?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeona fyekeo la Bwana Juma?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutazama mfano wa uendelezaji ufaao wa maumbo ya herufi kubwa kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutambua herufi kubwa katika kifungu kilicho kwenye kitabu, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali akiwa na wenzake,
kunakili kifungu akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi kubwa,
kuandika kifungu chenye maneno 25-30 akizingatia maumbo ya herufi kubwa ifaavyo akizingatia hatua za uandishi (maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi) na kuwasomea wenzake,
kumwonyesha mzazi au mlezi kifungu alichokiandika akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi kubwa ili akitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini tunatumia hati nadhifu katika uandishi?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kuandika kifungu kwa kutumia herufi kubwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu akizingatia maumbo ya herufi kubwa kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomwonyesha mzazi au mlezi wake kifungu alichokiandika akitumia maumbo ya herufi kubwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika maumbo ya herufi kubwa ipasavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika kifungu.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana kwa utulivu na wenzake kutathmini herufi kubwa alizoziandika.
sub_strands.pcis: Masuala ya kijamii na kiuchumi: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kutumia herufi kubwa ipasavyo.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kuandika herufi kubwa anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua herufi kubwa katika matini
kuandika kifungu cha hadithi akitumia herufi kubwa ifaavyo
kufurahia kuandika kwa kuzingatia herufi kubwa katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika kwa hati nadhifu ukitumia herufi kubwa ifaavyo
skills.mastery: Writes a passage of about 25-30 words in neat handwriting: letters well formed and on the line, capitals only at the start of a sentence or name, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Writing a neat passage (Theme 1) is the base for using capitals in it.
Writing capital letters in words and sentences (Grade 2).

misconceptions.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.

example.question: Andika kwa usahihi: juma na amina wanalima shambani.

misconceptions.cause: The child copies words, not sentences; the rule that a sentence and a name begin with a capital is not yet used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika kwa usahihi: juma na amina wanalima shambani." with "juma na amina wanalima shambani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle the first letter of each sentence and each name in a passage in red.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi na jina la mtu au mahali huanza kwa herufi kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts capital letters in the middle of words (JuMa, Kitabu KiKubwa).
misconceptions.cause: Some capitals (K, M, S) are easier to form than the small letter, so the child uses them anywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "JuMa ANakula" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort letter cards: capital only at the start; the rest small.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi kubwa iko mwanzoni tu; nyingine ni ndogo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves no space between words (Mamaanapika).
misconceptions.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a finger space after every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
misconceptions.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Umoja na Wingi wa Sentensi (Theme 2: Shambani)

kusoma sentensi katika umoja na wingi akiwa na wenzake,
kujaza nafasi ili kukamilisha sentensi katika umoja na wingi akiwa na wenzake,
kuambatanishe umoja na wingi wa sentensi alizopewa kwenye kitabu, chati, vifaa vya kidijitali, n.k akiwa na wenzake,
kuigiza michezo inayohusisha sentensi katika umoja na wingi akiwa na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi katika umoja na wingi wa sentensi akiwa na wenzake,

Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi katika umoja na wingi.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kusoma sentensi katika hali ya umoja na wingi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza nyenzo zinazotumiwa katika ujifunzaji wa sentensi za umoja na wingi.

kutunga sentensi katika umoja na wingi

skills.name: Badilisha sentensi kutoka umoja hadi wingi na kinyume chake
skills.mastery: Turns a short sentence from singular to plural and back, changing the noun by its ngeli (kiatu - viatu, mti - miti, jembe - majembe) and every word that agrees with it, including the verb, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Singular and plural of word groups (Grade 2) come before whole sentences.
Yeye/wao and the verb that agrees with them show agreement in the sentence.

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu -> watabu).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows that wa- makes people plural and uses it for everything; the ngeli of the noun is not yet known.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "Kiatu kimechafuka" ni?" with "Wiatu wamechafuka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort noun cards into ngeli families (m-wa, ki-vi, li-ma, n-n) and say each plural aloud.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (Viatu vimechafuka.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Changes the noun but not the verb or the word that agrees with it (Vitabu kimeanguka).
misconceptions.cause: The child changes the word he was asked to change and stops there.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika kwa wingi: Mti umeanguka." with "Miti umeanguka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Colour the noun prefix and the verb prefix the same; read the sentence and check every coloured part.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi nzima hubadilika: Vitabu vimeanguka. (Miti imeanguka.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Shows the plural only with a number word and leaves the noun singular (kitabu mbili).
misconceptions.cause: English and some first languages keep the noun and add a number; Kiswahili changes the noun and the number agrees.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "jembe moja" ni?" with "jembe mbili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Line up two books: the child says vitabu viwili; then three: vitabu vitatu.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (majembe mawili)
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a noun of the n-n class a plural prefix (nyumba -> manyumba), or changes an irregular noun wrongly (jicho -> majicho).

example.question: Andika kwa wingi: Ng'ombe anakula nyasi.

misconceptions.cause: The child expects every plural to look different; n-n nouns stay the same and some li-ma nouns change their stem.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika kwa wingi: Ng'ombe anakula nyasi." with "Mang'ombe wanakula nyasi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a short list of the same-in-both nouns (nyumba, ndizi, kalamu) and the irregular ones (jicho - macho, jino - meno).
misconceptions.feedback: Baadhi ya nomino hazibadiliki, na baadhi hubadilika kwa njia yake. (Ng'ombe wanakula nyasi.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the plural form for the singular (miti for one tree, vitabu for one book).

example.question: Ni sentensi ipi iko katika umoja?

misconceptions.cause: The child heard the plural more often (a tree is usually among trees) and learnt it as the name.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni sentensi ipi iko katika umoja?" with "Miti imeota." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold one object, then many; the child names each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kimoja ni kitabu; vingi ni vitabu. (Mti umeota.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Maneno ya Heshima na Adabu (Theme 3: Miezi ya mwaka)
learning_experiences: kutazama michoro, picha au video inayowasilisha vitendo vya heshima na adabu akiwa na wenzake,
kutambua maneno ya adabu na heshima kutoka kwa michoro, picha au video aliyotazama (tasfida) (k.v. kwenda msalani, haja kubwa, haja ndogo, kuendesha),
kuigiza mazungumzo yanayoonyesha matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kujadiliana na mzazi au mlezi maneno ya heshima na adabu katika jamii yake.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni kwa nini tunatumia maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mawasiliano?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutazama picha, michoro na video kuhusu maneno heshima na adabu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotambua baadhi ya maneno ya adabu na heshima na matumizi yake.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya adabu na heshima ipasavyo.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia na kutunza vifaa vya kidijitali ipasavyo.
Uadilifu: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika maigizo ya mazungumzo ya maneno ya adabu na heshima.
sub_strands.pcis: Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kuigiza maneno ya heshima na adabu.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya heshima na adabu anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala la mieza ya mwaka na miezi ya mwaka inayofundishwa katika somo la Mathematics Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno ya heshima na adabu katika matini
kutumia maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mawasiliano
kuthamini matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia maneno ya heshima na adabu: tafadhali, asante, samahani, pole, karibu
skills.mastery: Picks and uses the polite word that fits the situation (tafadhali or naomba to ask, asante to thank, karibu to answer asante, samahani to apologise, pole to sympathise) and addresses an adult with a title, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Using the words of respect and courtesy of Grade 2 is the base.
Greeting properly comes before a polite request.

misconceptions.error: Says samahani when someone else is hurt by accident, where pole (sympathy) is meant.

example.question: Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?

misconceptions.cause: English "sorry" covers both apology and sympathy; Kiswahili separates them: samahani when I did wrong, pole when you suffer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?" with "Samahani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two pictures: I stepped on your foot (samahani); you fell by yourself (pole). The child names each.
misconceptions.feedback: Pole ni ya kumhurumia aliyeumia; samahani ni ya kuomba msamaha ukikosea.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers "Asante" with "Asante" instead of "Karibu" (or "Si neno").

example.question: Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child echoes the polite word he has just heard.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?" with "Asante" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise the pair with two children: one gives, one thanks, the giver answers Karibu.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukishukuriwa, unajibu "Karibu."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Asks with a bare command (Nipe maji!) without tafadhali or naomba.

example.question: Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?

misconceptions.cause: At home and in play the child hears short commands and copies them to adults.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?" with "Nipe maji!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say both versions; the child says which one makes mama want to help.
misconceptions.feedback: Ombi la adabu lina "tafadhali" au "naomba."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls an adult by the bare first name without a title (Mwalimu, Mama, Baba, Bi., Bw.).

example.question: Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?

misconceptions.cause: Children call each other by name and carry the habit to adults.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?" with "Akinyi, njoo!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make title cards (Mwalimu, Mama, Babu, Daktari); the child puts one before each name.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtu mzima huitwa kwa heshima: Mwalimu, Mama, Babu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers "Pole" with "Pole" instead of "Asante".
misconceptions.cause: The child echoes the word, as with greetings.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuambia "Pole kwa kuumia." Unajibu?" with "Pole" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act it: one child is hurt, the other says pole, the hurt one says asante.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukiambiwa "pole" unashukuru: "Asante."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 3: Miezi ya mwaka)
learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 55 - 60 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi akizingatia picha kwenye kifungu,
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutabiri ujumbe wa kifungu kwa kutazama picha kwenye kitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali au chati akiwa na wenzake,
kuthibitisha utabiri wake kuhusu hadithi baada ya kuisoma,
kufafanua mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi majina ya miezi ya mwaka aliyojifunza ili amtolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo yapi unaweza kujifunza kutokana na unachokisoma?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi na kushiriki kikamilifu katika kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kikundi kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusoma na kutoa utabiri katika kifungu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kufanya maigizo kuhusu majina ya miezi ya mwaka.
Maadili:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili ujumbe katika kifungu.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anachotumia kujifunzia. Pia anapotekeleza majukumu aliyopewa anapofanya maigizo kuhusu miezi ya mwaka.
Haki za kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuimba nyimbo kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.pcis: Mahusiano ya kijami: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kufanya maigizo kuhusu majina ya miezi ya mwaka ukakamavu wake unajengeka.

outcomes.text: kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi: msamiati, ujumbe, kutabiri na mafunzo
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage on miezi ya mwaka, gives the meaning of a theme word from the sentence around it, says the message, predicts what happens next from the clues and says the lesson, answering from the passage and not from his own life, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: The four comprehension questions of Theme 1 come back here.
Theme vocabulary in a short story (Grade 2).

misconceptions.error: Gives "kusherehekea" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Mwezi wa Desemba, Baraka alisherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa. Alitimiza miaka minane. Mama alimwokea keki, na marafiki zake wakamwimbia." Neno "kusherehekea" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Soma: "Mwezi wa Desemba, Baraka alisherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa. Alitimiza miaka minane. Mama alimwokea keki, na marafiki zake wakamwimbia." Neno "kusherehekea" lina maana gani?" with "kusahau" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika kifungu, "kusherehekea" ni kufanya sherehe kwa furaha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Siku ya kuzaliwa ni siku ya furaha ya kukumbuka tulipozaliwa.

misconceptions.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Mama alioka keki." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Siku ya kuzaliwa ni siku ya furaha ya kukumbuka tulipozaliwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for.

example.question: Desemba ijayo Baraka atatimiza miaka mingapi?

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Desemba ijayo Baraka atatimiza miaka mingapi?" with "miaka minane tena" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the clue words; the guess must fit them.
misconceptions.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za kifungu: miaka tisa
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kufurahi pamoja na marafiki zetu.

misconceptions.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Marafiki walimwimbia Baraka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kufurahi pamoja na marafiki zetu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
misconceptions.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baraka alizaliwa mwezi gani?" with "Mimi nilizaliwa mwezi wa Machi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: Desemba
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutazama mfano wa uendelezaji ufaao wa maumbo ya herufi ndogo kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutambua herufi ndogo zilizoandikwa ifaavyo katika kifungu kilicho kwenye kitabu, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali n.k. akiwa na wenzake,
kunakili kifungu akizingatia mwendelezo ufaao wa herufi ndogo,
kuandika kifungu chenye maneno 55-60 akizingatia maumbo ya herufi ndogo ifaavyo akizingatia hatua za uandishi (maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi) na kuwasomea wenzake,
kushirikiana na wenzake kuandika kifungu kifupi akizingatia mwendelezo ufaao wa herufi ndogo,
kuwaonyesha wenzake kifungu alichoandika akizingatia maumbo ya herufi ndogo ili waitolee maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unazingatia mambo gani unapoandika herufi ndogo ifaavyo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadili na wenzake kuhusu jinsi ya kuendeleza herufi ndogo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kutazama kielelezo cha uendelezaji ufaao wa maumbo ya herufi ndogo.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli ya kuandika kifungu kifupi akizingatia mwendelezo ufaao wa herufi ndogo,
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapowaonyesha wenzake kazi aliyoandika ili waitolee maoni.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika kisa kifupi kuhusu mada lengwa kwa kutumia herufi ndogo.

outcomes.text: kutambua herufi ndogo zilizoandikwa ipasavyo katika kifungu
kuandika kifungu akitumia herufi ndogo ifaavyo
kufurahia kuandika kwa kuzingatia herufi ndogo ifaavyo

skills.name: Andika kwa hati nadhifu ukitumia herufi ndogo ifaavyo
skills.mastery: Writes a passage of about 55-60 words in neat handwriting: letters well formed and on the line, small letters of the right height, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Writing a neat passage (Theme 1) comes first.
Writing small letters in their right shapes (Grade 2).

misconceptions.error: Writes the tall small letters (b, d, h, k, l) short, so h looks like n.

example.question: Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not use the lines of the book: tall letters must reach the top line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "nabari" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write on three-line paper; the child colours the part of h that goes up.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi h, k, l, b, d hupanda juu ya mstari wa kati.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes some small letters as big as capitals (kiti written kiTi or KITI).

example.question: Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Capitals were learnt first in pre-primary and feel safer to write.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?" with "KITI" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare k/K, s/S, t/T on cards; the child picks the small one for the middle of a word.
misconceptions.feedback: Ndani ya neno tumia herufi ndogo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves no space between words (Mamaanapika).
misconceptions.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a finger space after every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
misconceptions.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matumizi ya Maneno Yule na Wale (Theme 3: Miezi ya mwaka)
learning_experiences: kutambua matumizi ya neno yule na wale kutoka kwenye chati, kitabu, vyombo vya kidijitali nk. akiwa na wenzake,
kusilikiliza kifungu au wimbo kuhusu matumizi ya neno yule na wale kutoka kwa mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au vifaa vya kidijitali na kujadili matumizi yake akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma sentensi zilizotumia neno yule na wale kutoka kwenye chati, kitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali akiwa na wenzake,
kuigiza vitendo vya kuwaashiria watu mbalimbali kwa kutumia neno yule na wale akiwa na wenzake,
kuandika sentensi akitumia yule na wale (k.v Mtoto yule anacheza - watoto wale wanacheza) na kuzijadili na wenzake ili kuzitolea maoni,
kujaza nafasi ili akamilishe sentensi akitumia yule na wale,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kazi aliyoandika kuhusu matumizi ya yule na wale.
key_inquiry_questions: Unaweza kutunga sentensi zipi ukitumia maneno yule na wale?

Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia neno yule na wale kwa lugha fasaha.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi kwa kutumia neno yule na wale.

Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapotungiana sentensi kwa kutumia neno yeye na wao.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli ya kikundi.

outcomes.text: kutambua matumizi ya neno yule na wale katika kifungu
kutumia neno yule na wale katika sentensi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya neno yule na wale katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tumia yule na wale ipasavyo katika sentensi
skills.mastery: Uses yule for one person or animal far away and wale for many, tells them from huyu/hawa (near), and uses kile/vile, not yule, for things of the ki-vi class, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Huyo and hao (Grade 2) are the pointing words before yule and wale.
One and many in two-word groups (Grade 2).

misconceptions.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).
misconceptions.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kiti ___ (kilicho mbali) ni kizuri." with "yule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (kile)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Watoto ___ (walio mbali) wanacheza." with "yule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
misconceptions.feedback: Watoto ni wengi: watoto hawa. (wale)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes near and far pointing words (huyu for someone far away; yule for someone close).

example.question: Mtoto yuko karibu nawe. Unasema: Mtoto ___ ni rafiki yangu.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not linked the forms to distance from the speaker.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtoto yuko karibu nawe. Unasema: Mtoto ___ ni rafiki yangu." with "yule" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand near one child and far from another; point and say huyu and yule; then swap places.
misconceptions.feedback: Huyu ni karibu nami; yule ni mbali. (huyu)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.
misconceptions.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mwalimu ___ (aliye mbali) anafundisha." with "hii" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (yule)
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua silabi za sauti lengwa (/py/, /vy/, /sh/) katika matini mbalimbali (k.v kadi maneno, chati, mti maneno, au kifaa cha kidijitali),
kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali (k.v. kupitia programu ya papaya) kusikiliza matamshi bora ya sauti lengwa,
kusikiliza silabi za sauti lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali (k.v. kinasasauti na rununu) akiwa na wenzake kisha azitamke,
kusikiliza maneno yenye sauti lengwa yakisomwa na mwalimu kisha atambue sauti lengwa katika maneno hayo,
kutamka maneno yenye sauti ifaavyo akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu kifupi chenye maneno ya sauti lengwa kutoka kwa kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali akiwa na wenzake.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia mambo gani unapotamka maneno mbalimbali katika kifungu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kutamka maneno yenye sauti lengwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujirekodi akisoma kifungu na kutambua jinsi alivyotamka sauti lengwa.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake wa jamii mbalimbali katika kutekeleza shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana katika kikundi kutambua na kutamka maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshima matamshi ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Amani: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa utulivu katika kutambua silabi za sauti lengwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka sehemu mbalimbali kusoma kifungu chenye maneno ya sauti /py/, /vy/ na /sh/ kuhusu suala lengwa.

skills.name: Tambua na utamke silabi za sauti /py/, /vy/, /sh/ katika maneno na sentensi
skills.mastery: Hears and says the target sounds /py/, /vy/, /sh/ in syllables and words (kipya, vyakula, shamba), splits a word into its syllables, and picks or uses a word that carries the sound, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Every Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel; the child must know the vowels to split the syllables of py, vy, sh.
Hearing the syllables of a target sound in Grade 2 comes first.

misconceptions.error: Says /s/ for /sh/, so "shamba" becomes "samba".

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "shamba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /sh/, or do not separate it from /s/; the child puts in the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "shamba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "samba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza: "shamba" ina sauti /sh/, si /s/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "vyakula" is said "viyakula".
misconceptions.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "vyakula". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "viyakula" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
misconceptions.feedback: "vyakula" ina silabi vya-ku-la; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "kipya" becomes "kipa".

example.question: Neno "kipya" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

misconceptions.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "kipya" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "kipa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "kipya". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits "kipya" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "kipya" lina silabi zipi?" with "k-i-p-y-a" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ki-pya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /py/, /vy/, /sh/?" with "kalamu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
misconceptions.feedback: "vyakula" ina sauti lengwa; "kalamu" haina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha. Sauti /py/, /vy/, /sh/) (Theme 4: Kazi mbalimbali)
learning_experiences: kutambua sauti lengwa (/py/, /vy/, /sh/) katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 49 kwa dakika na kwa kuizingatia viakifishi) akiwa na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo akiwa na wenzake,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora,sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara zifaazo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unahakikishaje umesoma kifungu kwa ufasaha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia kikamilifu katika kutambua sauti lengwa na kusoma kifungu.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa.
Kujithamini: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akitumia matamshi bora sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara zifaazo.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua sauti na kusoma kifungu.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini wenzake wanaposhirikiana kusoma kifungu cha maneno yenye sauti lengwa.

kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora

kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo
kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti /py/, /vy/, /sh/ kwa matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Finds the target sounds /py/, /vy/, /sh/ in a short story, reads it aloud with every sound clear, loud enough for the class, at about 49 words a minute, pausing at the koma and kikomo and raising the voice for a question; in the app picks the better reading of a line, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Saying the syllables of py, vy and sh comes before reading them in a passage.
Reading aloud at a fitting pace and volume, from Theme 2.

misconceptions.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "vyombo" as "viombo".
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "vyombo" linasomwa vipi?" with "viombo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma "vyombo" kama lilivyoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Fundi alitengeneza kiti kipya."?

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Fundi alitengeneza kiti kipya."?" with "Fundi ... alitengeneza ... kiti ... kipya." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 49 kwa dakika

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, mpishi ameosha vyombo vyote?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, mpishi ameosha vyombo vyote?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
